in_sanskrit.name: Ayrika
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of Life
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ayrika एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Ayuh’ meaning ‘life’ and ‘Rik’ meaning ‘Goddess’. Ayrika is the goddess who bestows the blessings of long and healthy life. She is also associated with creativity, beauty, and joy.
